$ () aikito status
--- stdout
--- stderr
[ERROR] Workspace migration is incomplete: <HOME>/aikito
Run: aikito migrate workspace-resources
--- exit 1
$ () aikito migrate workspace-resources --dry-run
--- stdout
[CREATE] agents/codex.toml
[CREATE] agents/claude-code.toml
[UPDATE] subagents/reviewer.md
[REMOVE] agents.toml
[REMOVE] subagents.toml
[DRY RUN] No files changed
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ () aikito migrate workspace-resources
--- stdout
[RECOVER] Interrupted workspace migration recovered
[CREATE] agents/codex.toml
[CREATE] agents/claude-code.toml
[UPDATE] subagents/reviewer.md
[REMOVE] agents.toml
[REMOVE] subagents.toml
[SUCCESS] Workspace resource layout migrated
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ () aikito migrate workspace-resources
--- stdout
[SUCCESS] Workspace resource layout migrated
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ () aikito show subagents
--- stdout

| Subagent | Claude Code | Codex |
+----------+-------------+-------+
+----------+-------------+-------+
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ () aikito sync subagents --dry-run
--- stdout
--- stderr
